prompt: Loudness in decibels is $10 \times \log_{10}$ of the sound intensity. A concert is $1{,}000{,}000$ times as intense as a whisper. How many decibels louder is the concert?

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up: if a sound were $100$ times as intense, then $\log_{10}(100) = 2$ and $10 \times 2 = 20$ decibels louder. Same two moves, bigger number.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count the zeros
steps: With base $10$, the log is just the number of zeros.
$1{,}000{,}000$ has six zeros, so the log is $6$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Ten decibels at a time
steps: Every $\times 10$ in intensity adds exactly $10$ decibels.
A million is six tens multiplied together.
Six of those jumps add $6 \times 10 = 60$ decibels.
